scope: Protected notifications that arrive between a native Observe cancellation or Max-Age renewal and its response

standard.name: IETF OSCORE
standard.summary: A client stops processing a message that fails verification, and an error in a notification does not cancel the observation

source_identity.kind: exact source-file SHA-256; no source commit association asserted

defects.observed: A notification sent after the worker's cancellation and before the peer's confirmation ended the cancel command with security_handshake_failed; a notification in flight across a Max-Age renewal ended the observation with observation_failed
defects.cause: libcoap keeps one OSCORE association per token and refreshes it when the cancellation or renewal is sent, so a notification protected for the registration fails verification; the worker treated that failure as fatal whenever a request was pending

defects.observed: With the worker discarding that failure, the peer's genuine cancellation confirmation still failed with no security context association and the command returned timeout
defects.cause: libcoap deleted a non-Observe request association on any response decryption error, including one from a message that never verified

assertions: While an observation exists, OSCORE decryption, missing-protection and decoding failures are discarded and a pending renewal or cancellation continues to its own response or deadline
Patch 0009 deletes a request association only after a correlated message verifies
The harness holds the cancellation in the unserviced peer socket and sends a notification ahead of it; the peer handles the cancellation after generating that notification
With report credit open, the intervening notification writes no report and is not cancellation success
When the peer confirms, the cancel command returns result null; when the peer only acknowledges, it returns timeout at its 1,000 ms deadline
In both cancellation cases no later output follows, the peer has no observer and exactly one cancellation arrives
A notification sent after the Max-Age renewal and before the renewal is handled is discarded; the renewal response delivers report 2 with the new value and a later cancel returns result null

The preceding helper returns security_handshake_failed for the confirmed cancellation and observation_failed for the renewal; the worker change alone returns timeout for the confirmed cancellation; patch 0009 alone fails both cases

unaccepted: An authenticated stale or duplicate notification during a pending renewal, which renewal admission exempts from serial ordering
Verification of a notification protected for the registration after a renewal or cancellation refreshed libcoap's single token association
